name: roko-workspace
description: MCP execution workspace for Roko: per-conversation files and a network-less sandbox.

scripts.test:docker: docker build --target test -t roko-workspace:test . && docker run --rm --cap-drop ALL --cap-add SYS_ADMIN --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --security-opt apparmor=unconfined --security-opt systempaths=unconfined --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,mode=1777 --tmpfs /data:rw,nosuid,nodev,mode=0700,uid=1000,gid=1000 roko-workspace:test
